```{r data, echo = FALSE}
library(knitr)

source('scRNA_func.r')
source('reportFunctions.R')

myoptiontbl = fread("fileList3.txt", header = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Value=V1, Parameter=V2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Parameter, Value) %>% as.data.frame()

myoptions<-read_file_map("fileList3.txt", do_unlist=FALSE)

is_glimse = "glmm_method" %in% names(myoptions)
if(is_glimse){
  myoptions$DE_by_cell=1
  myoptions$newcriteria=is_one(myoptions$newcriteria, 0)
}

tool_name = ifelse(is_glimse, "GLIMES", "edgeR")

is_between_cluster = is_one(myoptions$bBetweenCluster)

outFile<-myoptions$task_name
folder_prefix = ifelse( is_one(myoptions$DE_by_cell), 
                    paste0(outFile, ".", tool_name, "_by_cell/"), 
                    paste0(outFile, ".", tool_name, "_by_sample/"))
file_prefix= paste0(folder_prefix, outFile, ".")

if(length(readLines("fileList1.txt")) > 1){
  group_def<-read.table("fileList1.txt", sep="\t", header=F, stringsAsFactors = F)
  group_def <- group_def |> 
      dplyr::group_by(V2) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Samples = paste0(V1, collapse = ",")) |>
      dplyr::select(V2, Samples) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      dplyr::distinct()
  if(is_between_cluster){
    colnames(group_def)<-c("Group", "Cluster")
  }else{
    colnames(group_def)<-c("Group", "Samples")
  }
}else{
  group_def<-NULL
}

comp_def<-read.table("fileList2.txt", sep="\t", header=F, stringsAsFactors = F)
has_category = ncol(comp_def) == 3
if(has_category){
  colnames(comp_def)<-c("Group", "Category", "Comparison")
}else{
  colnames(comp_def)<-c("Group", "Comparison")
  comp_def = comp_def %>% 
     group_by(Comparison) %>% 
     mutate(Samples = paste0(Group, collapse = ", ")) 
  comp_def$ControlGroup = gsub(",.+","",comp_def$Samples)
  comp_def$SampleGroup = gsub('.+,\\s*',"",comp_def$Samples)
  comp_def = comp_def[,c("Comparison", "ControlGroup", "SampleGroup")]
  comp_def = comp_def[!duplicated(comp_def$Comparison),]
}

de_files <- read.csv(paste0(outFile, ".", tool_name, ".files.csv")) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(row_number()))

num_cell_file = paste0(file_prefix, "num_cell.csv")
if(file.exists(num_cell_file)){
  num_cell<-read.csv(num_cell_file)
}else{
  num_cell<-NA
}

designMatrix=readRDS(paste0(outFile, ".allCompMatrix.rds"))
comparisons<-unique(designMatrix$comparison)
```

---
title: "`r tool_name` differential expression analysis"
author:
- name: `r myoptions$email`
  affiliation: `r myoptions$affiliation`
---

```{r}
if(!is_between_cluster){
  comp=comparisons[1]
  for(comp in comparisons){
    cat("\n#", comp, "\n\n")
    designs<-subset(designMatrix, comparison == comp)
    comp_files<-subset(de_files, comparison == comp)

    cts = as.character(designs$cellType)
    ct<-cts[1]

    sig_file_map=unlist(split(comp_files$sigFile, comp_files$cellType))

    sig_list=lapply(sig_file_map, function(x) read.csv(x, row.names=1))

    nums=lapply(sig_list, function(x){
      n=nrow(x)
      np=sum(x$logFC > 0)
      nn=sum(x$logFC < 0)
      return(c(n, np, nn))})
    
    nums_df<-do.call(rbind, nums)
    colnames(nums_df)<-c("num_sig_gene", "num_up_regulated", "num_down_regulated")

    cat("\n## Number of DE genes\n\n")
    num_sig_file = paste0(file_prefix, comp, ".num_sig.csv")
    write.csv(nums_df, num_sig_file)
    print_table(nums_df, row.names=TRUE)

    ct = cts[1]
    for(ct in cts){
      cat("\n## ", ct, "\n\n")
      file_prefix=designs$prefix[designs$cellType == ct]
      error_file=paste0(file_prefix, ".error")
      if(file.exists(error_file)){
        errors=readLines(error_file)
        errors=paste0(errors, collapse="\n")
        cat("\n### DE warning\n\n<mark>", errors, "</mark>\n\n")
      }

      if(!ct %in% comp_files$cellType){
        next
      }

      ct_files<-subset(comp_files, cellType == ct)

      ct_comp_name = paste0(celltype_to_filename(ct), ".", comp)
      
      design_file=ct_files$designFile[1]
      design_data=read.csv(design_file)
      de_by_cell = "Cell" %in% colnames(design_data)
      if(de_by_cell){
        design_data=design_data[!duplicated(design_data$Sample), c(1,3,4)]
      }
      design_data=design_data |> dplyr::arrange(Group, Sample)

      cur_prefix = ifelse(de_by_cell, file_prefix, folder_prefix)

      if(!all(is.na(num_cell))){
        if("cell_type" %in% colnames(num_cell)){
          ct_num_cell<-subset(num_cell, cell_type == ct)
        }else{
          ct_num_cell<-subset(num_cell, cluster == ct)
        }
        ct_cell_map<-split(ct_num_cell$num_cell, ct_num_cell$sample)
        if(all(design_data$Sample %in% names(ct_cell_map))){
          design_data$Num_of_cell<-ct_cell_map[design_data$Sample]
        }
      }

      cat("\n### Design table\n\n")
      print_table(design_data, row.names = F)

      mds_png<-paste0(cur_prefix, ct_comp_name, ".mds.png")
      if(file.exists(mds_png)){
        cat("\n### Multidimensional scaling plot\n\nPlot samples on a two-dimensional scatterplot so that distances on the plot approximate the expression differences between the samples.\n\n")
        add_img(mds_png, width_inch=10)
      }

      pca_png<-paste0(cur_prefix, ct_comp_name, ".pca.png")
      if(file.exists(pca_png)){
        cat("\n### PCA plot\n\n")
        add_img(pca_png, width_inch=10)
      }

      heatmap_png<-paste0(cur_prefix, ct_comp_name, ".log_cpm.heatmap.png")
      if(file.exists(heatmap_png)){
        cat("\n### heatmap plot\n\n")
        add_img(heatmap_png, width_inch=10)
      }

      sig_file=sig_file_map[[ct]]
      sig_data=read.csv(sig_file, header=T, row.names=1)
      if(nrow(sig_data) == 0){
        cat("\n### No significantly differential expressed genes\n\n")
      }else{
        cat("\n### Significantly differential expressed genes\n\n")
        print_table(sig_data, byDT=TRUE, DT_in_loop = TRUE, escape=TRUE, digits=3, nsmall=2)

        volcano_png<-paste0(cur_prefix, ct_comp_name, ".volcano.png")
        if(file.exists(volcano_png)){
          cat("\n### Volcano plot\n\n")
          add_img(volcano_png, width_inch=10)
          if(is_glimse){
            if(myoptions$newcriteria){
              cat("\n<mark>Since GLIMES considers average log2 gene expression when determining significance, genes with low average expression levels may not be identified as differentially expressed, even if they have low p-values and large absolute fold changes.</mark>\n\n")
            }
          }
        }

        top_gene_dotplot = paste0(cur_prefix, ct_comp_name, ".top_dotplot.png")
        if(file.exists(top_gene_dotplot)){
          cat("\n### Top gene dotplot\n\n")
          add_img(top_gene_dotplot, width_inch=10)
        }      

        top_gene_figures = paste0(cur_prefix, ct_comp_name, ".top_", c(1:5), "_gene.png")
        top_gene_figures = top_gene_figures[file.exists(top_gene_figures)]
        if(length(top_gene_figures) > 0){
          cat("\n### Top ", length(top_gene_figures), " gene plot\n\n")
          for(top_gene_png in top_gene_figures){
            add_img(top_gene_png, width_inch=10)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```


```{r}
if(is_between_cluster){
  cts = comparisons
  sig_file_map=unlist(split(de_files$sigFile, de_files$comparison))

  sig_list=list()

  ct = cts[1]
  for(ct in cts){
    sig_file=sig_file_map[ct]
    sig_data<-read.csv(sig_file, row.names=1)
    sig_list[[ct]] = sig_data
  }

  nums=lapply(sig_list, function(x){
    n=nrow(x)
    np=sum(x$logFC > 0)
    nn=sum(x$logFC < 0)
    return(c(n, np, nn))})
  
  nums_df<-do.call(rbind, nums)
  colnames(nums_df)<-c("num_sig_gene", "num_up_regulated", "num_down_regulated")

  cat("\n# Number of DE genes\n\n")
  num_sig_file = paste0(outFile, ".num_sig.csv")
  write.csv(nums_df, num_sig_file)

  print_table(nums_df, row.names=TRUE)

  ct = cts[1]
  for(ct in cts){
    cat("\n#", ct, "\n\n")
    ct_files<-subset(de_files, comparison == ct)
    
    design_file=ct_files$designFile[1]
    design_data=read.csv(design_file)
    de_by_cell = "Cell" %in% colnames(design_data)
    if(de_by_cell){
      cell_num = table(design_data$Group)
      if(length(unique(design_data$Sample)) == 1){
        design_data=design_data[!duplicated(design_data$Group), c(1,4)]
      }else{
        design_data=design_data[!duplicated(design_data$Group), c(1,3,4)]
      }
      design_data$Num_of_cell<-cell_num[design_data$Group]
      if("Sample" %in% colnames(design_data)){
        design_data<-design_data |> dplyr::select(-Sample)
      }
    }else{
      if(!all(is.na(num_cell))){
        ct_num_cell<-subset(num_cell, cell_type == ct)
        ct_cell_map<-split(ct_num_cell$num_cell, ct_num_cell$sample)
        design_data$Num_of_cell<-ct_cell_map[design_data$Sample]
      }
    }

    cat("\n## design table\n\n")
    print_table(design_data, row.names = F)

    sig_file=sig_file_map[[ct]]
    sig_data=read.csv(sig_file, header=T, row.names=1)
    if(nrow(sig_data) == 0){
      cat("\n### No significantly differential expressed genes\n\n")
    }else{
      cat("\n### Significantly differential expressed genes\n\n")
      print_table(sig_data, byDT=TRUE, row.names=TRUE, DT_in_loop=TRUE)

      volcano_png<-gsub(".sig.csv", ".volcano.png", sig_file)
      if(file.exists(volcano_png)){
        cat("\n### Volcano plot\n\n")
        add_img(volcano_png, width_inch=10)
        if(is_glimse){
          if(myoptions$newcriteria){
            cat("\n<mark>Since GLIMES considers average log2 gene expression when determining significance, genes with low average expression levels may not be identified as differentially expressed, even if they have low p-values and large absolute fold changes.</mark>\n\n")
          }
        }
      }

      top_gene_dotplot = gsub(".sig.csv", ".top_dotplot.png", sig_file)
      if(file.exists(top_gene_dotplot)){
        cat("\n### Top gene dotplot\n\n")
        add_img(top_gene_dotplot, width_inch=10)
      }

      top_gene_figures = paste0(gsub(".sig.csv", "", sig_file), ".top_", c(1:5), "_gene.png")
      top_gene_figures = top_gene_figures[file.exists(top_gene_figures)]
      if(length(top_gene_figures) > 0){
        cat("\n### Top ", length(top_gene_figures), " gene plot\n\n")
        for(top_gene_png in top_gene_figures){
          add_img(top_gene_png, width_inch=10)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
